facts.text: I want to plan a trip in Dubai and Abu Dhabi for 1 week for a couple.
I want to visit different cool places during the trip.
I want all days of the trip to be planned.
I want to visit both Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
I have a low budget for the trip.
I want the answer in a markdown format.
I want one day per table.
I want to indicate a cost of visit if it is not free.
I want the most important places marked with a star.
I want to spend several days on a beach.
I want to redesign the schedule.
The first and last days of the schedule are fully available.
The first and last days have no transfers and travels.
I want an extra table with middle budget activities.
I want an extra table with low and middle budget cafe, street food, or restaurants recommended to visit.
In the cafe/food table, I want the format to be place, average check, and the most famous dish.
I want x3 more options added to the last 2 tables.
I want additional low budget activities.
I want links that will make Google Calendar events with all-day schedules.
The first day for the Google Calendar events is 22th April 2023.
The last day for the Google Calendar events is 29th April 2023.
For each place, I want geo information, cost, and working time.

events.text: Plan a trip in Dubai and Abu Dhabi for 1 week for a couple.
Redesign the schedule with first and last days fully available and no transfers/travels.
Create Google Calendar all-day event links for the trip from 22th April 2023 to 29th April 2023.
